description: Observed weekly influenza-and-pneumonia deaths from the NCHS surveillance table.
Expected weekly benchmark deaths supplied in the same surveillance table rather than re-estimated locally.
Jurisdiction-week deviation from the table-provided benchmark.
Observed, expected, and excess weekly values were summed over the same influenza-season window within each jurisdiction.
Primary seasonal outcome interpreted as a surveillance benchmark contrast, not an age-standardised causal estimand.
